selection_method: secrets.choice over all 16 existing scenarios with no redraw

scenario.name: Cobalt Travel Operations
scenario.story: A travel operations assistant resolves disruption cases by checking schedules and hotel systems. It typically invokes a model four times but complex cases take up to twelve calls. About 1,500 cases arrive daily. Tool results influence the next action.
scenario.acceptance: Preserve variable call expansion; do not replace it with one call.
scenario.measurement_next: Sample complete case traces, retries, model calls and context growth.
